say:2:1230303001:1.text: Of course! Just look at who designed it!
say:2:1230303001:1.source_cn: 那是，也不看看火炮是谁研发的？
say:2:1230303001:1.male: Of course! Just look at who designed it!
say:2:1230303001:1.female: Of course! Just look at who designed it!

say:3:1230303002:1.text: Everything made by the dwarf craftsman is top-notch!
say:3:1230303002:1.source_cn: 血薇帮的百炼工坊，矮人工匠亲手打造，当然是精品！
say:3:1230303002:1.male: Everything made by the dwarf craftsman is top-notch!
say:3:1230303002:1.female: Everything made by the dwarf craftsman is top-notch!

say:4:1230303003:1.text: But we're just guards. We don't seem to have much to do with this achievement...
say:4:1230303003:1.source_cn: 可我们俩只是守卫，火炮好像和咱们关系不大……？
say:4:1230303003:1.male: But we're just guards. We don't seem to have much to do with this achievement...
say:4:1230303003:1.female: But we're just guards. We don't seem to have much to do with this achievement...

say:5:1230303004:1.text: That's nonsense! If we hadn't been repelling the Water Wights, the development wouldn't have gone so smoothly!
